criteria.name: artifact_set_exists_and_parses
criteria.description: All ten declared artifacts exist and the nine JSON reports parse as objects.

criteria.name: canonical_serialization_and_integer_units
criteria.description: Every JSON report has sorted keys at every level, a trailing newline, no float or boolean, and a JSON integer at every place the schema gives an integer field.

criteria.name: report_keys_match_schema
criteria.description: Every object in the eight region, segment, audit and quality reports carries exactly the schema keys for its place.

criteria.name: report_arrays_in_schema_order
criteria.description: Every array in the shipped-data reports has one entry per item in the order schema.md gives.

criteria.description: Raising the public segment rate adder in program.ini moves the credits of the region file as the contract says, with the same portfolios.

criteria.description: Raising one site's allowance_ticks in site_allowances.tsv moves the candidates and portfolios of the later events that site takes part in, and no compliance label.

criteria.description: Raising minimum_grant_cents in program.ini moves the grants of the region file as the contract says, with the same portfolios and credits.
